name: AVX512 blocked SGEMM (sep_gemm.c) correctness + benchmark
micro_kernel: 8 rows x 48 cols (24 zmm accumulators), AVX512 FMA, broadcast A from memory into FMA
tiling: MC=128 NC=2048 KC=256; OpenMP over M-tiles (N-tiles when M small)
caveat: Shared VM (1.5 CPUs): repeat runs of the same shape/config swing 2x (matmul 3072->384 measured 119 and 52 GFLOPS in different runs). NC/KC tuning sweep (768/384, 3072/384, 1024/128) showed differences smaller than the run-to-run noise; keeping NC=2048 KC=256. Projection uses worst observed rates.
design_decision: 3x3 convs run as im2col-tiled GEMM (M=output positions, N=48 out-channels, K=432) at ~118 GFLOPS, NOT shift-and-add 1x1 GEMMs (23 GFLOPS: small-M/huge-N orientation streams the 151 MB input across 3 MB-strided rows). 1x1 convs run as out^T GEMM (M=HW, N=Cout, K=Cin) at 63 GFLOPS. MatMul nodes use sgemm directly.
